stages.diagnostic: Unable to satisfy B1 with any of the first 36 shells; Wannier90 suggested increasing search_shells above its default search.

interpretation: The failure occurred before .nnkp generation or localization. It reflects Wannier90's automatic three-dimensional finite-difference-shell search for a 128x1x1 mesh, not a calculated localization failure and not evidence against the direct composite result.
proposed_correction: Set search_shells to at least 65, with 130 recommended so the search can reach unit reciprocal vectors in the inactive one-point y and z directions, then repeat preprocessing under renewed retry authority.
later_disposition: The human authorized search_shells = 130 under checkpoint RM-PERIODIC-1D-W90-RETRY-HC02. The bounded retry and subsequent localization executions are recorded separately in wannier90-execution.json and wannier90-result.json.
claim_boundary: This record establishes only one failed Wannier90 preprocessing attempt. It establishes no localization, interpolation, numerical verification, scientific validation, or human acceptance.
